contractRules.rule: Role rows are catalog data: each T03 semantic-profile row carries its role rows and each T04 project-profile row its project roles. Adding a role is a data change (CAT0 CR13). Rows are ordered by the canonical encoding of RoleId (CAT0 CR05) and are part of the CatalogSnapshot identity (VID0 I09). No role table exists beside the snapshot.

A role row declares exactly one origin: PackageExport { entries } listing every admitted CanonicalExport (package name, export subpath, export name, Value|Type space) of the exact release explicitly, with no prefix, glob or package family; or ProfileIntrinsic { region role, name, scope law Reserved|UnshadowedFree }.

A role row declares its phase: Projection (decidable from the ER05-ER09 link forms without types) or PostSnapshot (needs the shared type resolver). A PostSnapshot role never activates projection and feeds DEM0 P3 only; it is never promoted to Projection.

A profile intrinsic is proven only inside its declared region role, under its scope law, for the admitted release. An import of the same name from a package is not intrinsic evidence; the call outside the region is NotRole { OutsideRegion }.

Captured links: named import (including renamed); namespace import plus a static dot member or string-literal computed member; const object destructuring of a namespace binding with identifier or string-literal keys; immutable const alias whose initializer is a link, through parentheses and the erasable TS wrappers as, satisfies, non-null and angle-bracket assertion; local barrels (export { x as y } from, export *, export * as ns, import then export {}).

Not captured: dynamic import(), require, module.exports and CommonJS interop, optional-chained members, non-literal computed keys and rest elements (NotRole { Unsupported }); a default import of a role export the release does not declare as default (NotCanonical); a free reference with no binding (NotRole { Unbound }) unless ER09 binds it through a project-profile contribution.
A type-only link carries only Type-space roles; a Value-space role reached through one is NotRole { TypeOnlyLink }.

Chains are followed one module hop at a time. Each hop reads only the module-resolution answer for its specifier (the shared import-route authority today, the PM resolution proof once it exists) and the hop module parse-domain export inventory (IndexedReady exports). No TypeScript, no ProjectSemanticDispatch, no TypeInfo, no package declaration bodies, no raw-source rescan.

The terminal is canonical only when the hop resolves into a package-backed module (workspace_is_package_backed) whose manifest name and export subpath equal a role-row entry. A specifier that a paths or alias mapping sends to a workspace file is workspace-owned: NotRole { NotCanonical }, whatever its bytes. A project-profile contribution hop is a link only when the profile generated facts declare it, and it records that contribution identity.
Shadowing: the binding lexical scoping resolves for the head (blocks, parameters, catch, class and function names, hoisting) is the only first link; a nearer non-link binding is NotRole { Shadowed }.

Mutation: only import and const bindings are links. let, var, parameters and object properties are NotRole { Mutable } even when never reassigned; a local function or class declaration of the same name is NotRole { LocalDeclaration }; a re-export of a mutable workspace binding is Mutable.
Wrappers: a call, .bind, new, spread, or object or array literal around a link is NotRole { Wrapped }.
Conditionals: ?:, &&, ||, ??, destructuring or parameter defaults and assignment under control flow are NotRole { Conditional }.
An unresolved hop or a package with no proven installed release is Unproven { needs }: never a warm negative, never a name guess; later proof mints a new evidence identity (DEM0 DR24).

Two export * providers supplying the name with different terminals are Ambiguous { candidates } and prove no role. Two paths to one terminal are not ambiguous; the recorded chain is the least by canonical encoding.
Revisiting a (module, export name) pair is NotRole { Cycle }; exhausting the BudgetProfile hop bound is BudgetExceeded (ReturnOnly).

Closed outcome set: Proven, NotRole { cause }, Unproven { needs }, Ambiguous { candidates }, BudgetExceeded, Cancelled. Only Proven activates. Unproven, Ambiguous, BudgetExceeded and Cancelled are ReturnOnly (DEM0 DR30). NotRole is definitive and cacheable only when every read in its read set completed.

RoleEvidence::Proven carries site (SourceUnitId, SourceRevision, authored range), RoleId, chain (LocalImport, NamespaceMember, Destructure, ConstAlias, ReExport { module, specifier bytes, export name }, ProjectContribution { ProjectProfileId, contribution identity }) in authored-to-terminal order, terminal CanonicalExport, package name plus admitted ReleaseId, and read set.

The read set lists, in canonical encoding order: the site unit parse-domain facts identity; every hop module (SourceUnitId, ContentId) export inventory; every module-resolution answer consulted including negative probes; the manifest identity (name, export-map digest) and installed release of each package touched; the role-row identity in CatalogSnapshot; any project-profile contribution identity. Evidence identity is the canonical tagged encoding of (site, role, outcome, read-set identity) (VID0 R12, R13), with no path string and no backend or process identity (VID0 R14).

Invalidation follows the read set exactly: an edit to a member invalidates exactly the evidence that read it; a non-member edit invalidates nothing; edit-then-revert yields the same identity; incremental equals fresh. A changed evidence identity reaches DEM0 stage one only as a new stage-one plan (DEM0 DR12, DR13).
Query keys stay content-free; validity is the read set, revalidated on every warm hit; work admitted under a superseded epoch never publishes (DEM0 DR25).
Deterministic order: evidence by site range then RoleId encoding; chains authored to terminal; ambiguity candidates by canonical encoding; registration, discovery and completion order never decide.

Projection-phase evidence is DEM0 P2 role input (DR07); PostSnapshot evidence is P3 input (DR11). Verticals read evidence by RoleId and never re-derive a role from an identifier, callee name, import-source string, file extension or text search.

A projection region opens only from Proven evidence of a Projection role whose row declares that region (for example the template option of a proven Vue defineComponent call). Region geometry and codecs are EMB0.

No oracle: evidence production calls no TypeScript provider and no TCM3 stage and executes no package. PostSnapshot roles use the shared type resolver only inside P3, through the exact-route authority resolve_authored_reference_route.
Under the DEM0 Explain purpose (DR17) consumers surface the Proven chain and the cause of every other outcome; audit capture is optional and required evidence state survives capture off.

Evidence is computed only for role sites a demand reaches whose head binds to an import, a namespace or a captured contribution; each hop module export inventory is read once per (SourceUnitId, ContentId); a unit with no such binding does no evidence work beyond its existing import inventory (DEM0 DR26, DR27).
A TypeInfoRequest never carries a role name, package spelling or specifier as a selector; framework surfaces are addressed through P3 claims (TIF0 owns the request vocabulary).

The corpus is export-activation-case-table.v1.json; each positive case has a same-spelling negative differing only in the failing link. EAK1 builds and runs it in its existing test lanes; EAK0 ships no test.
Runtime compile backends keep the official compiler recognition of intrinsics under Compiled-Output Conformance (EAK-B01); a backend needing a PackageExport role reads RoleEvidence like any consumer.

findings.finding: is_vue_wrapper and factory_export accept a free (unbound) defineComponent, defineOptions or factory name as Vue's; ER06 makes it NotRole { Unbound } (EAK-D05).

Alias semantics disagree across the IDE collectors: vue_runtime_macro_imports and generate_options_api_stub key on the local name (an aliased real import is missed or double-injected; import { x as defineComponent } is accepted), while three other collectors key on the imported name.
classify_macro and ScriptPropFacts::note_value match the callee spelling without consulting a binding; ER04 makes the scope law row data checked against the release.

bare_specifier_package_name takes the leading specifier segment once the resolved file is package-backed, so a paths mapping of svelte onto another package's file claims svelte; ER09 takes the name from the resolved manifest.

$bindable, $inspect, $props and the rune-name lists each have two to four spellings across the Svelte runtime and IDE paths, and the Svelte IDE uses text prefilters (contains("$props"), contains("$host")). The IDE copies are EAK-D08's population; the runtime copies stay EAK-B01.
prefer_import_from_vue lists five internal @vue/* packages while its replace_content fix handles four, missing @vue/composition-api.

resolve_authored_reference_route already composes authored aliases, imports, re-exports and local alias hops into a ResolvedReferenceRoute with exactness. It is the PostSnapshot half of ER25; the Projection half (ER08) must reach the same chain without the type resolver, and EAK1 proves the two agree on PostSnapshot cases (EC30).
